insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

waiting_periods.description: 30 days for any illness/hospitalization from policy commencement. Not applicable to accidental injury or subsequent continuous renewals.
24 months for specified procedures/illnesses: Cataract, Hernia, Hydrocele, Congenital internal diseases, Hysterectomy, Calculus diseases, Joint replacement, Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy.
36 months of continuous coverage for declared pre-existing diseases. Optional buyback rider allows reduction to 12 months on payment of additional premium.
24 months of continuous coverage for normal and caesarean delivery expenses.

pre_existing_disease_definition: Any condition, ailment, injury or disease that is/are diagnosed by a physician within 36 months prior to the effective date of the policy issued by the insurer, or for which medical advice or treatment was recommended by, or received from, a physician within 36 months prior to the effective date of the policy or its reinstatement.
exclusions: Investigation & Evaluation (Code-Ex04): Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostic and evaluation purposes only.
Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care (Code-Ex05): Expenses related to any admission primarily for bed rest and not for receiving active medical treatment.
Obesity/Weight Control (Code-Ex06): Surgical treatment of obesity unless clinical BMI thresholds are met as per IRDAI guidelines.
Cosmetic or Plastic Surgery (Code-Ex08): Expenses for cosmetic or aesthetic treatments unless necessitated by accidental burn or injury.
Hazardous or Adventure Sports (Code-Ex09): Treatment resulting from professional participation in hazardous or adventure activities.
Breach of Law (Code-Ex10): Expenses incurred for treatment directly arising from committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent.
Substance Abuse (Code-Ex11): Treatment for alcoholism, drug abuse, or solvent abuse.
Unproven Treatments (Code-Ex16): Expenses related to any unproven, experimental, or non-clinically established treatment methods.
claim_notification_requirements: Emergency Hospitalization: Intimation to insurer/TPA within 24 hours of hospital admission.
Planned Hospitalization: Intimation to insurer/TPA at least 48 hours prior to admission.
required_documents: Duly completed and signed claim form
Hospital main bill and itemized break-up bill with doctor visit details
Hospital payment receipts with cash/card payment proofs
Discharge summary with complete clinical notes, admission date, and discharge date
Diagnostic investigation reports (Blood, ECG, X-Ray, MRI, Histopathology)
Medical prescriptions for medicines bought outside hospital with original pharmacy bills
KYC documents and cancelled cheque leaf with printed account holder name
cashless_conditions: Available exclusively at Star Health empaneled network hospitals across India
Cashless pre-authorisation form to be submitted via hospital insurance desk with initial admission advice
Decision communicated within 1 hour as per IRDAI Master Circular 2024
Final discharge authorisation granted within 3 hours of receiving final bill and discharge summary
repudiation_conditions: Claim repudiation must be approved by the designated Claims Review Committee (CRC)
No repudiation on grounds of non-disclosure after 60 continuous months of coverage (Moratorium Clause)
Repudiation letter must state the specific policy clause and detailed medical reasoning
grievance_procedure: Policyholders may register grievances via email at gro@starhealth.in or online at https://www.starhealth.in/grievance-redressal/. If unresolved within 15 days, escalate to Bima Bharosa or the regional Insurance Ombudsman.
